purpose: Fresh verification of structured-state HTTPS JSON retrieval, independently checked with curl.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('.').resolve()
reg=json.loads((root/'canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
matches=[(cid,e) for cid,e in reg.items() if e.get('status')=='VERIFIED_BOUND_CAPABILITY' and (e.get('source') or {}).get('type')=='pypi']
assert len(matches)==1,matches
cid,entry=matches[0]
sel={'id':cid,'record':entry}
sel_rel='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/HTTP_JSON_VERIFY_SELECTION.json'
out_rel='canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/HTTP_JSON_VERIFY_LIVE.json'
(root/sel_rel).write_text(json.dumps(sel,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
p=root/'canonical/runtime/bound_capabilities/http_json_fetch.py'
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('hf',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
res=m.run({'source_json_path':sel_rel,'url_key':'metadata_url','output_path':out_rel,'max_bytes':5000000},root)
url=entry['source']['metadata_url']
assert shutil.which('curl')
curl=subprocess.run(['curl','-fsSL','-H','Accept: application/json',url],capture_output=True,timeout=60)
assert curl.returncode==0,curl.stderr[-1000:]
a=json.loads((root/out_rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
b=json.loads(curl.stdout.decode('utf-8'))
assert a['info']['name']==b['info']['name']==entry['source']['project']
assert a['info']['version']==b['info']['version']
an={(x.get('filename'),(x.get('digests') or {}).get('sha256')) for x in a.get('urls',[])}
bn={(x.get('filename'),(x.get('digests') or {}).get('sha256')) for x in b.get('urls',[])}
assert an==bn and an
print(json.dumps({'adapter_result':res,'project':a['info']['name'],'live_version':a['info']['version'],'independent_semantics_equal':True,'curl_sha256':hashlib.sha256(curl.stdout).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
print('STRUCTURED_HTTP_JSON_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
